context:
Goal: one page answer starts the lane it approves, with no second click, on the right branch.
Problem (rule): two records disagree on what a lane is, and the Mac path cost you three clicks and two lanes on the wrong branch.
Based on (record): lanes-start-as-agents says a lane is an agent the coordinator starts, which needs no click from you.
Based on (read): in a cloud session, a coordinator starts a lane session on any turn with no card; this coordinator has started more than 30 since Nov 1.
Departs from: main lets the two records disagree — the place a run happens decides: on the Mac a lane is an agent started from the coordinator's own checkout; in the cloud it is a session.
holds: Any lane started from a page answer; no lane starts until you pick. A debt record for the second click is filed meanwhile.

options.gain: No card and the right branch, on the Mac and in the cloud.
options.how: On the Mac, a page answer starts its lane as an agent with its own worktree, cut from the coordinator's checkout, so the coordinator's branch stays the base. In the cloud, a lane session. Every lane brief also opens by creating its branch from the named base.
options.label: Agent on the Mac, session in the cloud
options.lose: On the Mac a lane ends when the coordinator's session ends, and it shares the Mac's load brake.

options.how: At the start of a run, on your word in chat, the coordinator starts idle lane sessions; later page answers reach them by message.
options.label: Idle lane sessions at run start
options.lose: The coordinator must guess how many lanes to start; idle sessions wait; a card still drops the branch unless each brief creates its branch.

options.how: The coordinator asks for the lane start in chat in the same turn it files the page item.
options.label: Ask for the start in chat
options.lose: It works only when you answer in chat, not on the page.

options.how: Let a session in another account read page answers directly, so no relay is needed.
options.label: Fix the page read across accounts only
options.lose: The account limit is outside the repo; the waiting-data copy in each repo already lets the owning session read answers from git; it does not remove the click.

ref: decisions session-tiers and lanes-start-as-agents; debt page-answer-second-click
title: How should one page answer start the lane it approves, with no second click and on the right branch?
why: Two records disagree. session-tiers (the session shapes) says the coordinator starts lane sessions. lanes-start-as-agents says a lane is a background agent, and a new session starts only on your own words. On the Mac, a session started by another session needs you to press a card, and the card drops the branch. The apartment coordinator took the session path: you pressed three cards, and two lanes started from main instead of the apartment-tv branch.
